SPEED/CONS BASED UNDER GOOD WEATHER DAYS, UNDER NO ADVERSE INFLUENCE OF
CURRENT

AND SWELL WITH THE VESSEL LADEN UNDERDECK TO HER SUMMER SALTWATER LOADLINE,
FROM

SEA BUOY TO SEA BUOY, ALWAYS EXCLUDING CANALS, NARROW OR SHALLOW OR
RESTRICTED

WATERS, PERIODS WHEN SPEED IS REDUCED DUE TO CHRS' ORDERS, REASONS OF
SAFETY.

THE WORD "ABOUT" IN SPEED AND CONSUMPTION REFERS TO ALLOWANCE OF - 0.5KNOTS
IN SPEED

AND +5% ON CONSUMPTION RESPECTIVELY. CALCULATION OF VSLS PERFORMANCE ON BOTH

LADEN AND BALLAST PASSAGES HAS TO BE BASED UPON AN AVERAGE SPEED/CONS DURING

WEATHER DAYS UPTO BEAUFORT SCALE 4 AND DOUGLAS SEA STATE 3 AND MAX COMBINED
SEA

WAVE HEIGHT AND SWELL WAVE HEIGHT 1.25 METERS AND NO ADVERSE CURRENT.

 

PERIODS OF WEATHER IN EXCESS OF ABOVE CONDITIONS ARE TO BE EXPRESSLY
EXCLUDED FROM

CALCS. FOR A STEAMING PERIOD TO BE CONSIDERED AS A GOOD WEATHER ONE, ALL
PERIOD FROM

NOON TO NOON HAS TO BE IN GOOD WEATHER. FAVOURABLE CURRENTS SHALL NOT BE
TAKEN

INTO ACCOUNT WHEN CALCULATING VESSEL'S PERFORMANCE. NO EXTRAPOLATION OF
SPEED AND

CONSUMPTION TO BE MADE FOR WEATHER/SEA CONDITIONS OTHER THOSE DESCRIBED
ABOVE.

ALL DETS ABT
